steps.description:
A clash with another booking of the same room refuses to save, so the diary cannot double-book itself. When the room asks questions, they open in a dialog, and the answers are kept in Answers.

Pick a Room to continue.
steps.label: The Room
steps.title: The Room

steps.description: Pick bookable equipment for this booking. You can leave Room empty to book equipment only. Equipment that another booking holds at the same time is refused.
steps.label: Equipment
steps.title: Equipment

steps.description: End must be after Start. This pair is what the clash check compares, so a booking that starts exactly when another ends is fine.
steps.label: When
steps.title: When

steps.description: On a room that needs no approval a new booking is saved as Approved outright, so Requested always means waiting on an approver of the room, who gets a ToDo. Only an approver can move it to Approved. Blocked keeps the room free and refuses every request at that time; only an approver can block a time. Conflict is a booking that clashes and waits for an approver to choose.
steps.label: Approval
steps.title: Approval

steps.description: Tick this to send a booking that clashes to the approvers as a Conflict. A clash with a blocked time is always refused.
steps.label: Request Anyway
steps.title: Request Anyway

steps.description: Tick this when other groups can use the room at the same time. Two bookings that both have this ticked do not clash.
steps.label: Can Share Room
steps.title: Can Share Room

steps.description: Optional. Link the Function the room is for, so the event and the room it needs are not tracked in two unconnected places.
steps.label: Linked Function
steps.title: Linked Function

steps.description: Choose how the room is set up for this booking. The list shows only the setups of the room. Add Setup Notes for the people who set it up, and print the Setup Sheet for them.
steps.label: Setup
steps.title: Setup
